authorization_determination.question: Does frozen on-disk governance permit a second Stage 3 attempt after a failed first attempt?
authorization_determination.answer: Yes, by a new pre-registration declaring new candidates, sealed before any code for them exists. No erratum, no new project generation, and no separate human written approval is required at this gate.
evidence: SE100-GOV-0001 section 11, lines 290-291: 'A change that affects universe, timing, cost, signal, parameter range, metric, threshold, or data partition is material.' and 'A material change after seeing validation results creates a new candidate and restarts at Gate 3.' A new candidate restarting at Gate 3 is the mechanism this attempt uses. The scope gap is stated rather than glossed: the second sentence's trigger is 'after seeing VALIDATION results', and Attempt 1's results are development-only, so the clause does not literally cover this case. It is relied on a fortiori - if a material change made after seeing the more strongly protected validation results is permitted and costs no more than restarting at Gate 3, a material change made after seeing only development results cannot require more, and Gate 3 is where Attempt 2 begins. The constitution nowhere states a stricter consequence for the development case, and this attempt does not read the silence as permission for anything beyond restarting at Gate 3.

SE100-GOV-0001 section 11, line 293, the most directly on-point clause: 'Safety thresholds may be tightened without promoting a failed strategy, but the change must still be versioned.' Attempt 2 tightens safety - lower fixed exposure, entry-only volatility targeting, a per-position loss control, an account-level de-risking ladder - and promotes no failed strategy: F1 through F6 are not re-run, not edited, not superseded, and not carried forward. The versioning requirement is met by a new artifact id at version 1.0.0 rather than an edit to SE100-CFG-3001.
SE100-GOV-0001 section 2: 'Negative results are deliverables. Rejected strategies are recorded and not silently recycled.' Attempt 1 remains on disk, unmodified, and is cited rather than recycled.

SE100-GOV-0001 section 2: 'No result-driven rule changes. A failed gate cannot be weakened after results are observed.' No Gate 3 condition, threshold, denominator, predicate, boundary, or measurement is changed by this attempt.

denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.note: Restated from SE100-CFG-3002 for a reader, and enforced from that file. Nothing here is a new rule.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.total_return: final equity divided by starting equity, minus 1. Starting equity is the sealed USD 100.00. An equity curve with fewer than two points is NOT_EVALUABLE and fails.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.max_drawdown: largest peak-to-trough decline of the DAILY CLOSING equity curve, expressed as a non-negative fraction of the RUNNING PEAK. Session-close granularity; the project holds no intraday data and none is imputed.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.profit_factor: gross profit divided by gross loss over CLOSED trades only. Trade P&L is exit cash plus dividends received while held, minus entry cash, with both legs' costs inside. Open positions at window end are excluded from the numerator and the denominator alike.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.closed_trades: count of CLOSED round trips. Open positions at window end are not counted.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.best_trade_removal: a multiplicative equity reconstruction over closed trades in order, from E[0] = 100.00 with E[i] = E[i-1] + pnl[i] and r[i] = E[i]/E[i-1]. Realised return is the product of all r[i] minus 1; the removed-trade return is the product over i not equal to j minus 1.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.concentration: single-instrument closed-trade P&L divided by TOTAL closed-trade P&L, evaluated only when the total is strictly positive.
denominators_and_universes_of_measuremen.neighbour_stability: the SIGN of net return of each of the four neighbours, compared to the sign of the primary's net return. Magnitudes are irrelevant to the condition and zero matches nothing.

does_a_breach_cause_immediate_liquidatio.answer: Liquidation at the NEXT OPEN, not intraday and not at the breaching close.
does_a_breach_cause_immediate_liquidatio.reason: The engine's execution model has no intraday fill. The breach is detected at a session close and the liquidation fills at the following open, exactly as any other order does. The one-session lag is real, is charged, and is not modelled away.

is_deactivation_permanent.consequence: Once tripped, entries are blocked for the remainder of the run and the equity curve is flat from the liquidation onward. Every metric computed over the full window thereafter describes a short live period followed by a long dead one.
is_deactivation_permanent.attempt_1_observed: All six Attempt 1 candidates tripped it, earliest October 1997 and latest August 2010, which is why their full-window annualised figures were recorded as a limitation rather than reported as descriptions of the rules.

relationship_to_S3_C2.statement: The Gate 3 drawdown ceiling and the section 5.1 research shutdown are the same number, 15%, measured against the running high-water mark of the same session-close equity series. A candidate that trips the shutdown has by construction breached S3-C2, and its equity curve is flat from the liquidation onward.
relationship_to_S3_C2.equivalence: S3-C2 is MET if and only if the shutdown never fires.
relationship_to_S3_C2.attempt_2_use: This equivalence is Attempt 2's design target and is the reason RA1 exists. It is NOT a licence to treat a shutdown as anything other than a failure, and no Attempt 2 rule references the 15% level, the shutdown state, or the distance to it.

may_a_result_be_rerun_after_a_valid_comp.rule: Once a variant has completed a valid run over its full declared window under the sealed cost model, that result is the result. It is not re-run, not re-seeded, not re-ordered, and not recomputed in the hope of a different number. There is nothing to re-seed: SE100-CFG-3003 declares random_seeds null and every rule is deterministic, so a re-run of an unchanged variant must reproduce byte-identical output. A re-run that produced a DIFFERENT number would be a determinism defect and a blocker, not a better result.

when_a_rerun_is_required: A run that did not reach the development window end is NOT_RUN, not a result, and is re-run in full.

A software defect discovered after a result exists INVALIDATES that result per constitution section 10. The result is recorded as INVALIDATED, the fix is recorded, and ALL affected runs are re-run in full.
rerun_policy.prohibited: Selectively re-running only the variants whose numbers were disliked, extending a partial run rather than re-running it, or patching a completed result.
rerun_policy.no_specification_change_ever_follows_a_r: A change to SE100-CFG-3003 after any Attempt 2 result exists creates a new candidate under a new pre-registration and restarts at Gate 3. It never repairs a candidate declared for this attempt.

cost_stress_is_not_a_gate_3_condition.statement: Gate 3's seven hard conditions contain no stressed-cost condition. SE100-CFG-3003 declares three non-gating stressed-cost runs at 2x complete base friction to satisfy constitution section 7 and to put the number on disk for a later gate.
cost_stress_is_not_a_gate_3_condition.rule: A STRESS_FRAGILE flag cannot reject a candidate that satisfied every hard condition, and a clean stressed run cannot admit a candidate that failed one. The flag is evidence for Gate 4, not a Gate 3 criterion.
cost_stress_is_not_a_gate_3_condition.why_this_needs_saying: Adding evidence next to a gate is exactly how a gate quietly acquires an eighth condition. Declaring the non-gating status before any stressed number exists is what prevents it.

restated_for_a_reader: Verdicts are computed by program from recorded evidence, never asserted by a human reading a number.

A candidate's admissibility is the conjunction of its applicable conditions.
Comparisons are exact Decimal with no rounding before comparison.
The measured value is recorded alongside every verdict, so that a verdict can be checked against its own evidence.

items: Attempt 1's results are known to the researcher who wrote this file. This is an adaptive second attempt at Gate 3, not an independent first look.
All six Attempt 1 candidates breached the 15% maximum-drawdown ceiling. Some also failed the closed-trade-count floor, the profit-concentration condition, and the best-trade-removal condition.

The development data are no longer pristine with respect to at least the broad fact that the first candidate set produced excessive drawdown, and with respect to the per-candidate closed-trade counts recorded above. Attempt 2's design is conditioned on those facts.
Researcher degrees of freedom are higher in Attempt 2 than in Attempt 1, and false-discovery risk is correspondingly higher, because the design space was narrowed using an observed outcome.
The total experiment count for any later statistical interpretation is the cumulative count across both attempts, not Attempt 2's count alone. See cumulative_experiment_count.

No Attempt 2 result may be described as independent confirmation of anything merely because the code that produced it is new. The candidates share development data, a researcher, and a known prior outcome with Attempt 1.

Three of the three Attempt 2 candidates hold the entry and exit signal in the same rule FORM as a rejected Attempt 1 candidate. That is deliberate - the research question is about risk structure, so the return source is held fixed and the risk architecture is varied - and it means Attempt 2 is a second look at the same signals on the same data, not a new hypothesis about what predicts returns.
Validation-window and holdout-window protections are unchanged by this attempt. The validation window remains LOCKED and the holdout window remains SEALED.
A passing development result authorises only the next frozen evaluation step. It is not evidence of a trading edge, and it is not a claim about any future period.

This adaptation is not concealed behind a new strategy identifier. Each candidate id carries the RA1 suffix naming the shared risk architecture, and each candidate block states in distinction_from_attempt_1 exactly which rejected Attempt 1 candidate it shares its signal form with.

adaptive_research.multiple_comparisons_disclosure: Three candidates are tested against the same development data that six candidates were already tested against, by a researcher who knows how those six failed. A per-candidate criterion is not a family-wise one, and the probability that at least one of nine specifications passes by chance exceeds the probability that any single pre-specified one does. Because the Attempt 2 design space was narrowed by an observed Attempt 1 outcome, the effective search is wider than nine independent draws and cannot be bounded by counting runs. Nothing in this attempt corrects for it numerically. The correction the constitution relies on is that an admitted candidate must still survive Gate 4 robustness, Gate 5's single sealed holdout read, and the duration-based paper and shadow gates. Attempt 2 weakens none of those and earns no relief from any of them.

One parameterisation per family is not a test of the family. Three candidates were run; three families were not evaluated. The neighbour spreads show how much of each result belongs to the particular numbers chosen rather than to the rule.

The results are not comparable across candidates. The three run over different start dates because their largest lookbacks differ, on partly different regimes, and one trades a two-instrument universe. No ranking is implied, none was computed, and Gate 3 does not name a winner.

Base costs gate; the stressed scenario is a recorded diagnostic. Every gating result is therefore the optimistic case, and the cost model remains a proxy that cannot be validated before paper trading at gate 7.

Drawdown is measured at session closes because the project holds no intraday data and none was imputed, so an intraday excursion past the ceiling that closed above it is invisible to S3-C2 and every measured figure is a lower bound.

The per-position loss control compares the unadjusted close against the reference price, because the sealed rule writes close(symbol, t). On a split date the adjusted and unadjusted series diverge; this is a disclosed characteristic of the sealed specification, faithfully implemented, not an ambiguity resolved by discretion.

The 5% minimum cash buffer is a pre-trade constraint, not a post-trade invariant. The lowest cash fraction observed on any session is below 5% because a position marked up after entry raises the equity denominator; the constraint is evaluated when an order is sized, which is what the sealed engine specification requires.

Single-provider price data with unquantified residual fund-closure bias, split-adjusted prices only, and no as-traded price levels. A systematic provider error would pass every check in this stage undetected.

Every Stage 1 data limitation and every Stage 2 engine limitation is inherited whole. A research result cannot be more trustworthy than the engine, and the engine cannot be more trustworthy than its inputs.

measurement.basis: Closed trades only, in exit order. Because the sealed cost model permits at most one open risky position, trades are sequential and non-overlapping, so a compounded reconstruction is exact rather than an approximation.
procedure: E[i] = E[i-1] + pnl[i] for the i-th closed trade in exit order.
Per-trade equity multiple r[i] = E[i] / E[i-1].
Realized total return = product of all r[i], minus 1.
Best-trade-removed return = product of r[i] for i not equal to j, minus 1.
measurement.which_trade_is_removed: Two removals are computed and BOTH must leave a positive return. j1 is the trade with the largest equity multiple r[i]. j2 is the trade with the largest absolute P&L pnl[i]. These usually coincide and need not. Requiring both is the stricter reading, and it is fixed here so the stricter or looser reading cannot be chosen after seeing which one a candidate survives.

admissible_candidate_exists.required: admissible_candidate_exists is TRUE if and only if there exists at least one pre-registered Attempt 2 candidate for which EVERY applicable Gate 3 hard condition is SATISFIED, where satisfied means the condition's verdict is MET or NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT.
admissible_candidate_exists.verdict_semantics: This entry, and only this entry, is the gate determination.
admissible_candidate_exists.within_candidate: CONJUNCTIVE. All seven conditions are evaluated for every candidate; all applicable ones must be satisfied by that same candidate.
admissible_candidate_exists.across_candidates: DISJUNCTIVE. One admissible candidate is enough to pass Gate 3.

admissible_candidates_required.evidence: SE100-CFG-3002 verdict_token_derivation pass condition reads 'At least one pre-registered candidate satisfies EVERY hard condition of Gate 3'. Nothing in SE100-GOV-0001 section 9 gate 3 requires two or more.
admissible_candidates_required.and_no_more_than_one_is_needed: If more than one candidate is admissible, all of them are recorded as admissible. Gate 3 does not rank them and does not name a winner; selection is a later-stage decision. Attempt 2 declares no preference order among its three candidates.

evidence.combination_rule: Constitution section 9: gates are conjunctive; every hard condition must pass, and NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, or missing evidence is not a pass. Conjunction applies WITHIN a candidate. Across candidates the stage verdict is a disjunction, because Gate 3 asks whether a candidate worth carrying forward exists, not whether every candidate tried is good.
evidence.condition_token: At least one pre-registered candidate satisfies EVERY hard condition of Gate 3.

per_condition_rollup_is_not_the_gate.rule: A per-condition rollup row aggregates SATISFACTION across candidates and therefore means only 'at least one candidate satisfied this condition'. It is not evidence that any candidate satisfied all of them, and it settles nothing on its own.
per_condition_rollup_is_not_the_gate.required_reporting_shape: Each per-condition row must carry three separate lists - met_by, not_met_by, and not_applicable_for - so that a NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_CONDITION_TEXT verdict is visible as such rather than folded into a pass or a fail.
per_condition_rollup_is_not_the_gate.known_failure_mode_recorded: Aggregating a per-condition row on verdict == MET rather than on satisfaction produced a false FAIL for S3-C6 in Attempt 1's first rollup. The rollup must aggregate on satisfaction. It is recorded here so the same defect is not reintroduced by a fresh implementation.
per_condition_rollup_is_not_the_gate.decisive_row: The conditions table must carry the admissible_candidate_exists row, and that row alone decides the gate. A conditions table that omits it is misleading and is not an acceptable deliverable.

incoherent_combinations_refused: A PASS with zero admissible candidates.
A FAIL with at least one admissible candidate.
A PASS reached by treating NOT_EVALUABLE, NOT_RUN, UNKNOWN, or missing evidence as satisfied.
A PASS reached by aggregating per-condition rollup rows instead of evaluating conjunction within a candidate.
A verdict written into a decision package that is not the verdict the recorded evidence reaches.
